result:
Round 138 (V-0.4a) is finished on my side and ready for C. A's checks are green, but no browser row has run yet, so every C row in §5 is still open.

**What changed:** exactly the 24 granted paths and nothing else. The frozen list (931 entries) still checks OK, the protected files have no diff against `7e6202b`, and the end hashes are in `a-round-138/end-sha256.txt`.
- `strings.ts` has the new `studioClipStrings` object with the 20 keys CL1–CL20. It still imports nothing.
- `ArrangementClip.tsx` changed only in the import and the 25 listed lines. It now has no Georgian.
- `ArrangementContext.tsx` changed only in the import and l.1761, which is now `historyMoveClips(ids.length)`.
- 102 pin lines in the 17 test files are now hand-written English, with the same matchers and selector operators. Fixture track names are unchanged. Three of them needed Biome line wraps: `grid-snap-clip-edges` l.748 and l.759, and `video-fades-ui` l.316.
- `strings.test.ts` has the import, the deleted l.721 entry (ST13 now expects 3 lines), the ST33 retitle with an unchanged body, and the new ST34–ST35. The new `clip-strings-ui.test.tsx` has CSU1–CSU3.
- Doc 113 got its five line edits and doc 114 is new.

**Checks I ran:**
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0. The 218 lint warnings are all in files I didn't touch.
- Read-only Biome on the changed files gives 0 diagnostics.
- `npx vitest run` on the named list (25 files): 527 of 527 passed, saved to `a-round-138/vitest.json`.
- `strings.test` went from 33 to 35 `it`s; the 17 pin files have the same `it` counts as before.
- I did not run the full suite, `npm run verify`, the build or e2e; the gate runs those.

**Mutations:** all eight (m53–m60) turned at least one test red, and every file was restored and checked against its sha256 from before the mutation. One expectation in §3.5 was wrong: under m60 (left and right trim titles swapped), `gesture-reentry` stays green. That test only uses the left-edge title to find some trim handle, and after the swap it finds the other one. m60 is still caught by `grid-snap-edit` (7 red) and `track-layout` (1 red). The pin rules don't let me add an assertion to fix this, so B needs to rule on it.

**Code review (code-reviewer agent):** 9/10, no Critical, High or Medium findings. It reported three Lows, and I changed nothing for them:
- the m60 expectation above;
- ST35's length check only reads the test's own list, and depends on ST13 to compare it with the Context source;
- the literal `l.325` replacement in doc 113 reads "track-header selector (l.331)-ის selector", which says "selector" twice.

Its architecture note (a proposal for B, not acted on): add `data-testid`s to the trim handles and the range body so the tests stop finding them by title text. That would be a separate small task.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-138.md`. It includes which test covers each CL key and the exact checks C should run next.
